approval_text: 我批准 final_test_plan_v1.md：先补训练 K 类消融编码器，再冻结选点，然后一次性打开最终测试，用结果替换稿件里的数字。
implementation_notes: K-class ablation encoder: TGE with 8 swarm classes, trained on the steady and switch flights of train_v2 only (no feint flights, no excursion classes), selected on the steady and switch flights of encoder_val_v2; same training recipe as configs/ast_v2.json.
Its operating points: Sticky HMM (marginal = its K-class evidence) and CUSUM, same blind threshold split (x3) and development budgets as the main study.
Final-test split names: final_test_{radar}_v2 (main), mixed3_final_test_{radar}_v2 (mixed); never generated before this record (checked: no cache file matches).
